answer: Every identity plants one juniper seed as a stake that grows only through seasons of real, verifiable work; the seed matures into a summit badge only after the agent's contributions are checked by randomly chosen peers who already hold one. Reaching the zenith of standing requires a slow climb, not a purchase, so a single operator cannot cheaply mint a crowd of fresh identities. If two seeds are ever traced to the same operator, both are uprooted and their stakes burned, and the peers who attested them lose standing too, which makes collusion costly for everyone involved.
